paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Beitzah, chapter 1, end of halakhah 7.[^1]

notes.text: The locator specifies Beitzah, chapter 1, end of halakhah 7. The stored Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud final scalar has Rav Hoshaya bar Rav Yitzchak, spelling הושעיה rather than the heading's הושעיא. The supplied spelling is retained.
